subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When the product side rules on a requirement problem, the system shall apply the ruled change — a revision, an addition, or a retirement — to the PRD in the same feature draft and record the ruling's author, reason, and triggering problem.
rationale: The correction lands where it was found, attributably (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-9)
fit_criterion: 100% of requirement changes in fixture drafts carry author, reason, and triggering problem; a requirement change lacking any of the three is refused; a retired requirement appears as retired in the locked version.
